data.scope: Explicit test agent. All complete tickServer calls (normal or exceptional) in this window, including Neo Pre/Post; fixed bounded histograms, not rolling samples. Named nested method spans are inclusive/exclusive, not all summed. No game objects or file IO on server-thread probe callbacks.

clock.mapping_limit: Same-host shared OS realtime anchors, 1ms quantization plus observed drift. Never subtract raw nanoTime from different JVMs.

data.histogram_precision: Upper bounds, <=3.125% width above32ns; count/sum/max exact; each window is bounded to180000 ticks.

mod_roots.scope: Per complete tickServer on that thread: union of outermost selected mod method intervals, including zero on idle ticks. Nested scopes counted once. Generator is not a mod root, but selected children are. Outside-tick main-thread and non-main-thread roots are separate per-call wall histograms, never assigned to a nearby tick. This is wall time, not CPU time or all mod work.
mod_roots.coverage_limits: Explicit whitelist only. Includes actual TesseractBlockEntity.saveAdditional and selected compat.changed/AE insert-extract-inventory/GT energy mutation/Mek chemical-heat mutation entries. Uninstrumented GUI, other save/load hooks, other compat callbacks/getters, method prefixes/suffixes, and outside-tick work are excluded from the per-tick sum. Optional compat hooks with no actual calls remain unexercised; transformed_classes records actual loaded descriptors.
mod_roots.logical_tick_cycle_scope: Main-thread selected mod root union from one tickServer start to the next, including main-thread roots outside tickServer. Zero-work cycles count zero. A fixed live snapshot has one fewer completed cycle than completed tick frames; the current incomplete cycle is excluded. Stop seals at the next tick start, flushes the final complete cycle, and excludes that new tick frame; sealed cycles must equal tick frames. No raw cross-JVM clock subtraction and no claim of uninstrumented mod work or CPU time.

data.limits: Methods crossing window cutoffs/exceptional returns are not backend latency observations. Server/runtime samples include all completed instrumented calls; exceptional returns are separately counted. Calls crossing the cutoffs are excluded. Heap/GC/SQL asset counters are measured separately. Tracing copies identifiers/amounts only on the original calling thread.
